description:
Safer Living with Kate Sullivan: practical home defense, personal safety & security tips. 

All content published here is original and produced exclusively by our team.

Our Production Process:
Unlike curated, reposted, or compilation channels, we manage every stage of the creative process in-house.

Research & Scripting:
We conduct in-depth research into the history of tools, forgotten trades, old workshops, inventions, craftsmanship, and the stories behind the objects that built everyday life. Every video is developed from original research and written as a fully unique 
Script.

Voiceover & Audio:
All narration is recorded in-house, giving the channel a consistent, authentic storytelling style that fits the world of tools, trades, and forgotten work.

Visual Editing:
We use professional editing tools, including Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, to create engaging, high-quality videos that bring each tool, trade, and history to life.
